title: Support ticket triage pipeline
subtitle: Every ticket is triaged, then routed to a team-specific second stage. Two live Jev calls per run; the route the code takes depends on the first call's answer.

route.instructions: Route this support ticket to the right team.

criteria.billing: charges, refunds, invoices, payment methods, subscription cost
criteria.technical: bugs, errors, outages, something not working
criteria.account: login, access, password, profile, security settings
criteria.abuse: threats, harassment, fraud reports, policy violations

urgency.instructions: How urgently does the support team need to act?

needs_human.instructions: Does this need a human agent rather than an automated reply?

subtype.instructions: What specific billing issue is this?

criteria.double_charge: charged more than once for the same thing
criteria.invoice_question: a question about an invoice or receipt
criteria.cancel_or_downgrade: wants to cancel or move to a cheaper plan

churn_risk.instructions: Is this customer at risk of cancelling or churning?

criteria.true: threatens to leave, dispute, or cancel

auto_refundable.instructions: Can this be resolved by an automated refund without manager approval?

area.instructions: Which area does this technical issue fall under?

is_regression.instructions: Does the user indicate this used to work and recently broke?

issue.instructions: What account issue is the user reporting?

criteria.profile_change: wants to change email, name, or settings

security_sensitive.instructions: Could this be an account-takeover or unauthorized-access situation?

criteria.true: unexpected password/email change, locked out, suspicious access

verify_identity.instructions: Should we require extra identity verification before acting on this?

kind.instructions: What kind of abuse report is this?

credible_threat.instructions: Is there a credible threat to someone's safety?

escalation.instructions: How far should this be escalated?

examples.label: Billing
examples.state: I was charged twice for my annual plan this morning and I have emailed support three times with no reply. If this is not fixed today I am disputing the charge with my bank and cancelling.

examples.label: Outage
examples.state: Your checkout API has been returning 503 for the last ten minutes and our customers cannot pay. This was working fine an hour ago. We are losing sales every minute this is down.

examples.label: Locked out
examples.state: I just got an email that my password and recovery address were changed, but it was not me. Now I cannot log in at all and there is a new device on my account. Please help, I think someone broke in.

examples.label: Abuse report
examples.state: A user keeps messaging me through your platform saying he knows where I live and will come to my house this weekend. I have screenshots. I am genuinely scared for my safety.
